title: Graph Learning with Distributional Edge Layouts

problem.claim: GNNs learn through message passing along edges arranged in topological layouts, and layout choice can affect performance.

gap.claim: Existing methods generally obtain layouts from limited perspectives and overlook distributional information.

contributions.claim: Introduces Distributional Edge Layouts, which sample collections of topological layouts from a Boltzmann distribution under physical energies.
Integrates DELs with GNNs and reports that they can complement various GNN architectures.
Provides theoretical analysis that GNNs equipped with DELs maintain at least the same expressivity as their original counterparts.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Extensive experiments reportedly show consistent and substantial improvements across a wide range of GNN baselines and multiple datasets.
The method is reported to achieve state-of-the-art results.
DEL is open-sourced at the supplied GitHub repository.

narrative_sequence.summary: GNNs use topological layouts for message passing, and layouts can be important to performance.
The paper introduces DELs to sample multiple topological layouts from a Boltzmann distribution under physical energies.
DELs are integrated into GNNs to capture a broad landscape of feasible layouts and complement different GNN architectures.
Theoretical analysis addresses expressivity relative to original GNN counterparts.
Experiments report improvements and state-of-the-art results, with the improvement attributed to previously overlooked distributional information.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the physical energies or Boltzmann sampling procedure.
The datasets, baselines, metrics, and experimental conditions are not identified.
The conditions and scope of the expressivity analysis are not provided.
